root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `h3NeighborRotations()` indexes `NEW_DIGIT_II[oldDigit][dir]` for the resolution-13 class-III lookup, it must establish `oldDigit != INVALID_DIGIT`; checking only `isResolutionClassIII(r + 1)` leaves the table row index unvalidated.
root_cause_criterion.description: The selected root obligation is the missing invalid-digit guard on the resolution-13 class-III translation lookup. On the staged witness the loop reaches that lookup with `oldDigit == INVALID_DIGIT (7)`, so the vulnerable code indexes the 7-row `NEW_DIGIT_II` table with row 7.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The authoritative fixed original is guarded on the saved PoC because the inserted `oldDigit == INVALID_DIGIT` return fires before the resolution-13 table lookup. The adjacent `res13_digit6_boundary` perturbation changes only that resolution-13 digit to `IJ_AXES_DIGIT (6)`, yielding a genuine fixed witness where the same protected lookup executes with a valid row index.

nodes.state: At the selected resolution-13 class-III lookup, `NEW_DIGIT_II[oldDigit][dir]` still uses `oldDigit == 7` as the first-dimension row index, so the `Direction[7][7]` table is read one row past valid row 6.
